CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsDebugMode

Returns YES if debugging information will be appended to the current page, that is, if at least one of the debugging options (variables, processing time or query information) is enabled on the Debugging page of the Administrator and the page has not switched it off.

Category

Decision functions

Syntax

IsDebugMode()

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

<CFSETTING SHOWDEBUGOUTPUT="No"> switches debugging off for the rest of the request, after which IsDebugMode returns NO. Use it to show extra diagnostics only while you are developing, without having to remember to remove them before going live.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Debug mode right now: <B>#IsDebugMode()#</B>
</CFOUTPUT>
<CFIF IsDebugMode()>
  <P><FONT COLOR="Red">Developer note: this page was built at <CFOUTPUT>#TimeFormat(Now(), "HH:mm:ss")#</CFOUTPUT>.</FONT>
</CFIF>
<CFSETTING SHOWDEBUGOUTPUT="No">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>After CFSETTING SHOWDEBUGOUTPUT="No": <B>#IsDebugMode()#</B>
</CFOUTPUT>

CFSETTING, IsDefined, GetTickCount
